intro.sr: Posle sajma vlasnik vidi ko je ostavio kontakt, šta je dobio i ko je iskoristio kod. Ovde se podešavaju i nagrade, zalihe i QR kod za štampu. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: After the fair the owner sees who left a contact, what they won and who used the code. Prizes, stock and the QR code for printing are also set here. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
